```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
n <- sample(c(100,150,200),1)
d <- sample(12:30,1)
p <- round(d/n,3)
```
Question
========

In an inspection of `r n` units, `r d` defective units were found. The fraction defective is $p=`r p`$.

Which interpretation is correct?

Answerlist
----------

* Approximately `r round(100*p,1)`% of the inspected units were defective.
* Exactly `r round(100*(1-p),1)`% of future units will be conforming.
* The process is automatically in statistical control.
* The process capability index equals `r p`.

Solution
========

The fraction defective is the proportion of defective items in the inspected sample.
